snippet: bin/clean-node-modules Reclaim disk space across your repo and its git worktrees. Scans $PWD recursively, lists every top-level node_modules with its size, then deletes them after a single confirmation. Flags: -n dry-run, -y skip prompt, -h help.

title: bin/bigfiles
snippet: bin/bigfiles Refactor radar. Ranks every source file under $PWD by line count, skipping node_modules, .git, build, dist, .next, .nuxt, .turbo, .expo, .venv, __pycache__, .gradle, Pods, DerivedData, vendor, lock files, and minified bundles. Flags: -n top N (default 20), -t threshold, -e ts,tsx,js extension filter, -a count every file, --cloc full code/comment breakdown via cloc.
